task: Implement a read-only DONE closure runbook assistant for Lattice CLI.
outcome: When the user runs lattice done_closure --storyId=<story>, the terminal shows whether local DONE can be attempted, lists remaining closure blockers in gate order, and states Authority completion is NOT_CLAIMED unless a verified Authority receipt exists.
facts: B-cd1e is high-risk because it touches lifecycle/DONE guidance and Authority-adjacent wording.
The execution plan requires preserving TEST PASS != DONE and keeping delivery-check/summary as real gates.
core/done-oracle.ts already exposes buildDoneChecklist as the shared source for DONE gate and session_brief pre-check rows.
handlers/session.ts already renders DONE pre-check rows for TEST stories from buildDoneChecklist.
Local CLI and host audit evidence is Non-authority and cannot set receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone.
constraints: Do not weaken DONE gate behavior.
Do not duplicate DONE gate predicates when buildDoneChecklist can be reused.
Do not auto-write delivery-check.json or summary.json.
Do not claim Authority Server completion without receipt-backed proof.
Only fix the real correctness issue: agents need a stable closure runbook so TEST PASS is not mistaken for DONE.
